desc:
Welcome to Break Tape For Eggs!

HOW TO PLAY❓
1. Train to get stronger! 💪
2. Break tapes to continue to the next area! ✨
3. Steal an egg and bring it back to your base! 🥚
4. Avoid the angry animals running after you! 😡
5. Hatch the egg for an animal and get rich! 🐣
6. Buy better weights, upgrade your speed and unlock new areas! 🌍

Use code "RELEASE" for $2.5K Cash and a 10 Minute 2x Cash Potion!

Your eggs and money grow offline! ⏰

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
